entries.title: Vite preview blocks the Host header forwarded by the gateway (legacy G-001)

guard.command: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Host: raphtools.com' http://127.0.0.1:PORT/path/  # must be 200; vite.config preview.allowedHosts must include raphtools.com

enforcement.judgment: allowedHosts 寫在各 Vite 專案自己的 vite.config.ts，gateway 測試不讀；新服務接上 gateway 時有沒有加 host 靠人
